## agentckpt v0.2.0: agent hooks

Your coding agent now checkpoints the working tree itself: before each prompt, before each edit or shell command, and after each turn. Undo any step with `agentckpt restore <id> --force`, without touching your git branches or index.

### New

- **`agentckpt hook`**: one adapter for every agent's hooks.
  - Codex `notify` passes the JSON as the last argument. Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI lifecycle hooks pass it on stdin.
  - It finds the project from the payload `cwd` and writes messages like `claude: before Edit src/app.py`, ``codex: before Bash `rm -rf build` `` and `codex: turn complete "Rename foo to bar"`.
  - It always exits 0 and prints nothing on stdout, so it never blocks a prompt, denies a tool call or adds model context.
- **`agentckpt run -- <agent>`**: snap before and after any CLI (Aider, Cursor CLI, …).
- **Drop-in configs** in [`examples/`](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/tree/main/examples) for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI and OpenCode, plus shell wrappers.

### Quick start

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt
cd your-repo && agentckpt init
```

```toml
# ~/.codex/config.toml
notify = ["agentckpt", "hook", "--source", "codex"]
```

```jsonc
// .claude/settings.json
{ "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [{ "matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash",
  "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "agentckpt hook --source claude" }] }] } }
```

### Fixes

- Shadow-store git calls now drop inherited `GIT_INDEX_FILE` / `GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE`. Before this, a snap run from inside a git or agent environment could write to the user's real index.

Still zero runtime dependencies (stdlib + `git`). Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/agentckpt/docs/hooks/
